ExecutionPacket.contract-excerpt: Pipeline orchestrator: manages outgoing/incoming audio pipelines, STT→Translate→TTS chain
ExecutionPacket.verification-excerpt: cargo check must pass. pipeline_trace.log must show both pipelines starting.

assumptions.assumption-1: WASAPI audio devices are available on the system.
assumptions.assumption-2: Python 3.12 with faster-whisper is installed for Whisper fallback.

stop-conditions.condition-1: Stop if WASAPI device creation fails with 0x800706CC.
stop-conditions.condition-2: Stop if Deepgram API key is invalid.

FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Check network stability, disable VPN, or switch to Whisper/Yandex STT fallback.

FailurePacket.scenario: WASAPI 0x800706CC blocks audio capture device creation
FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Restart Windows Audio service, ensure no other app holds WASAPI COM references, reboot if persistent.
